description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers deriving a DTCG .tokens.json source of truth from brand decisions and emitting CSS/Tailwind + deck templates. Should-not covers near-miss neighbors: generic token authoring without a brand frame, defining (not emitting) identity, generation, validation, and a deck-render engine.

queries.q: turn our confirmed brand identity into design tokens
derive a .tokens.json source of truth from the brand colours and type
emit the brand as CSS variables and a Tailwind theme
export brand deck templates with the brand variables locked
generate the brand token system that pack-ai-image will consume
author a generic 3-layer token system for this app (no brand)
queries.note: generic token authoring with no brand frame -> design-tokens

queries.q: define the colour story and type story for the brand
queries.note: defining the identity constraint set -> brand-identity

queries.q: generate a logo from these brand tokens
check this component is using the brand tokens
render this brand deck to PDF / build a slide engine
queries.note: no render engine is owned (decision 7) — templates only
